# Matteo Paglietta

> Frontend & Web Developer based in Italy, building fast, accessible, SEO-friendly websites with React, Angular and WordPress.

Matteo Paglietta is a frontend and web developer focused on performance, accessibility and SEO. Open to freelance and full-time projects.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.matteopaglietta.it/): Portfolio, skills and selected projects.
- [Contact](https://www.matteopaglietta.it/#contact): Get in touch for project inquiries.

## Projects

- [Pepenero Cafè](https://pepenerocafe-menu.netlify.app): Digital menu website for a bar.
- [Armonie di Erica](https://github.com/MatteoPaglietta/armonie-di-erica-favaro): Landing page for a beauty salon.
- [BeatsBlend](https://beatsblend.netlify.app): Music tool that analyzes BPM and key to suggest compatible tracks.
